name: interpolate the probe position
mechanism: estimate where the target lies in a sorted range from the target's value relative to the range's end values, probe there, and shrink the range around the miss

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Predictive search' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence search: binary-like search which factors in magnitude of search term versus the high and low values in the search. Sometimes called dictionary search or interpolated se
